description: This file defines a React component and a class for providing command suggestions in a chat application, including handling user input, fetching command suggestions, and rendering suggestion UI.

classes.name: CommandProvider
classes.description: A class extending Provider that manages command suggestion logic, including handling user input, fetching suggestions, and rendering command suggestions.

methods.name: setProps
methods.description: Updates the properties and channel context for the command provider.

methods.name: handlePretextChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the input pretext, fetches suggestions, and determines whether to show command suggestions.

methods.name: handleCompleteWord
methods.description: Completes the current word with a space.

methods.name: handleMobile
methods.description: Fetches command suggestions for mobile pretext input.

methods.name: handleWebapp
methods.description: Fetches command suggestions for web application pretext input.

methods.name: shouldAddExecuteItem
methods.description: Determines if the 'execute current command' suggestion should be added.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a list of suggestions contains a specific complete string.
